profile.headline: software engineer
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer with expertise in the front-end technologies of React and with microservice technologies of Serverless and CDK. I have a passion for AWS and currently hold six of their certifications: Developer, Solutions Architect Associate, Sysops Administrator, Security Specialty, Big Data Specialty, and Machine Learning Specialty. I have an undergraduate degree in physics, however have many years of experience coding in a multitude of different languages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created an authorization service to give privileged users like school
administrators access more access and reports
• Implemented a custom authorizerfor all application API calls
• Developed and styled backbone of UI using React, HTML and CSS
• Made use of AWS DynamoDB to store the checked terms and condition as well
as to store whatreports a user was allowed to view
• Dynamically populated html in react based on a user’s information such as their
organization and the yearthey selected
• Setup systems using S3 and Lambda functions to determine that a user has
course authorization before allowing them to see the reports forthose courses
• Utilized encryption atrest and in transit
• Built logic to allow users to customize different views based on which year and
organization is selected
